plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and increase cash.
Trim CRWD to 10% to lower single name concentration.
Buy MRVL at 5% as a high-quality addition.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a significant cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower monthly gains, focusing on capital preservation. Expect reduced volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to manage leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and create a buffer.
Buy MRVL at 4% as a new, strong setup.
Slightly trim QQQI to 15% to rebalance.
This plan balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced mode seeks moderate growth while keeping risk in check. Expect a steadier path with controlled drawdowns, aiming for consistent, risk-adjusted returns.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to 6% each.
Buy MRVL at 6% and add to NVDA at 8% as top scanner setups.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and fund new positions.
This plan leans into leverage and high-conviction names for maximum growth.
Strict stop discipline is crucial due to amplified risk and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive mode aims for high growth by embracing leverage and concentration in top setups. Expect amplified gains but also significantly larger potential drawdowns and faster losses, especially with leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to remove leveraged ETF risk.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.

income.read: This income-focused mode prioritizes consistent monthly distributions over growth. Expect lower volatility and reliable income, but NAV can still decline in market downturns. Distributions are not guaranteed.
